notes.subject: עצה
notes.rationale: 'mĩtĩ' (miti ya kũringa) vs tũgĩrĩtwo ta 'mwanya/watho' — matukũ ma thaata ciatũũraga hapararia ya mbere ya kũringithania; 'mĩtĩ mĩraya' nĩ gũtaũra kwa kwĩhokia.

notes.subject: הפקד
notes.rationale: Paqad: 'kũhonorwo' (kũhũthwo) vs 'kũcumwo' vs 'kũũranwo' — KJV 'to be visited', JPS 'to be punished'.

notes.subject: סללה
notes.rationale: Kiugo kĩa kĩngeretha kĩa kũringa; 'kĩringi kĩa kũringa' nĩ gũtaũra kwagĩrĩirwo, ti kĩugo kĩmwe.

notes.subject: kũrĩ aũrĩri maũndũ
notes.rationale: Watho wa Yahwe Cebaoti ũrĩa wathĩnjiirio andũ a kũringa Yerucarayimu, ndũrĩrĩ cia kũhũrwo.

translation: Nĩgũkorwo Yahwe Cebaoti oigĩte ũguo: Mĩtĩ mĩraya ithĩnjwe, na kĩringi gĩa kũringa gĩkĩrwo gĩgũrũ rĩa Yerucarayimu; ũyũ nĩ gĩtũ kĩrĩa kĩagĩrĩirwo kũhonorwo, kĩnaigana kĩothe nĩ kũhunjia thĩinĩ wayo.
